item.title: A Script to Remove Imported-Style Symbols in InDesign
item.description: When you place styled content from Microsoft Word into InDesign, the paragraph and character styles from the Word document appear with symbols in the styles panels. The symbols certainly don’t do any harm, but they can be annoying to look at.
